# Step 6: 通路 ORA（KEGG / Reactome）

## 6.1 富集对象初始化（供 Step 6-8 共用）

```{r}
ensure_module_result_layout("06_enrichment")

de_result <- restore_main_de_result(required = TRUE)
sig_de <- de_result %>% filter(direction != "ns")

rank_file <- file.path(result_05_dir, "5_9_gene_rank_for_GSEA.rnk")
if (file.exists(rank_file)) {
  rank_tbl <- read.table(rank_file, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c("ENTREZID", "rank_score"))
} else {
  rank_tbl <- de_result %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), !is.na(rank_score)) %>%
    group_by(ENTREZID) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(rank_score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(rank_score))
}

go_bp <- NULL
go_mf <- NULL
go_cc <- NULL
go_all <- NULL
kegg_ora <- NULL
reactome_ora <- NULL
gsea_go <- NULL
gsea_kegg <- NULL
gsea_reactome <- NULL
gsea_go_df <- data.frame()
gsea_hallmark_df <- data.frame()
gsea_reactome_df <- data.frame()
gsea_mouse_m2_df <- data.frame()
gsea_mouse_m5_df <- data.frame()
gsea_human_hallmark_df <- data.frame()
gsea_human_c2_df <- data.frame()
gsea_human_c5_df <- data.frame()
hallmark_res <- mouse_m2_res <- mouse_m5_res <- mouse_kegg_res <- mouse_reactome_res <- list(result = data.frame(), pathways = list())
human_hallmark_res <- human_c2_res <- human_c5_res <- list(result = data.frame(), pathways = list())
go_ora_sets <- list(
  all = list(BP = NULL, MF = NULL, CC = NULL, ALL = NULL),
  up = list(BP = NULL, MF = NULL, CC = NULL, ALL = NULL),
  down = list(BP = NULL, MF = NULL, CC = NULL, ALL = NULL)
)
kegg_ora_sets <- list(all = NULL, up = NULL, down = NULL)
reactome_ora_sets <- list(all = NULL, up = NULL, down = NULL)
go_directional_df <- data.frame()
kegg_directional_df <- data.frame()
reactome_directional_df <- data.frame()
leading_edge_go <- data.frame()
leading_edge_kegg <- data.frame()
leading_edge_hallmark <- data.frame()
leading_edge_reactome <- data.frame()
leading_edge_mouse_m2 <- data.frame()
leading_edge_mouse_m5 <- data.frame()
leading_edge_human_hallmark <- data.frame()
leading_edge_human_c2 <- data.frame()
leading_edge_human_c5 <- data.frame()

human_result_dir <- file.path(result_06_dir, "human_ortholog")
human_table_dir <- file.path(human_result_dir, "tables")
human_plot_dir <- file.path(human_result_dir, "plots")
ensure_dirs(human_table_dir, human_plot_dir)
mouse_bundle <- get_pathway_gene_set_bundle("mouse_native")
human_bundle <- get_pathway_gene_set_bundle("human_ortholog")

sig_entrez_sets <- make_directional_gene_sets(sig_de, "ENTREZID")
sig_entrez <- sig_entrez_sets$all
geneList_symbol_fc <- build_gene_foldchange_symbol(de_result)

enrichment_universe_tbl <- de_result %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), ENTREZID != "")
if ("baseMean" %in% colnames(enrichment_universe_tbl)) {
  enrichment_universe_tbl <- enrichment_universe_tbl %>%
    mutate(baseMean_for_universe = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(baseMean))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(baseMean_for_universe), baseMean_for_universe > 0)
}
enrichment_universe_entrez <- unique(as.character(enrichment_universe_tbl$ENTREZID))
if (length(enrichment_universe_entrez) < 10) {
  enrichment_universe_entrez <- de_result %>%
    filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), ENTREZID != "") %>%
    pull(ENTREZID) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()
}
cat("[Step6] ORA background universe ENTREZID n=", length(enrichment_universe_entrez), "\n", sep = "")

for (one_direction in names(sig_entrez_sets)) {
  one_ids <- sig_entrez_sets[[one_direction]]
  if (length(one_ids) < 10) {
    cat("[Step5] 跳过", one_direction, "方向 ORA：有效 ENTREZID 少于 10 个\n")
    next
  }
  cat("[Step5] 开始", one_direction, "方向 GO/KEGG/Reactome ORA，gene_n=", length(one_ids), "\n")
  go_ora_sets[[one_direction]]$BP <- run_with_guard(
    label = paste("[Step5] GO ORA BP", one_direction),
    must_succeed = TRUE,
    fn = function() enrichGO(one_ids, OrgDb = annotation_orgdb, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
  )
  go_ora_sets[[one_direction]]$MF <- run_with_guard(
    label = paste("[Step5] GO ORA MF", one_direction),
    must_succeed = TRUE,
    fn = function() enrichGO(one_ids, OrgDb = annotation_orgdb, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "MF", universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
  )
  go_ora_sets[[one_direction]]$CC <- run_with_guard(
    label = paste("[Step5] GO ORA CC", one_direction),
    must_succeed = TRUE,
    fn = function() enrichGO(one_ids, OrgDb = annotation_orgdb, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "CC", universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
  )
  go_ora_sets[[one_direction]]$ALL <- run_with_guard(
    label = paste("[Step5] GO ORA ALL", one_direction),
    must_succeed = TRUE,
    fn = function() enrichGO(one_ids, OrgDb = annotation_orgdb, keyType = "ENTREZID", ont = "ALL", universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE)
  )
  for (one_ont in names(go_ora_sets[[one_direction]])) {
    # 保留当前项目 nominal pvalue < 0.05 的富集筛选口径；正式报告建议同时查看 p.adjust/qvalue。
    go_ora_sets[[one_direction]][[one_ont]] <- filter_result_by_pvalue(go_ora_sets[[one_direction]][[one_ont]], threshold = 0.05)
  }

  kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]] <- run_clusterprofiler_with_retry(
    label = paste("KEGG ORA", one_direction),
    fn = function() enrichKEGG(gene = one_ids, universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, organism = kegg_organism_code, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1),
    attempts = 3,
    sleep_seconds = 5,
    must_succeed = FALSE,
    timeout_seconds = 600
  )
  kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]] <- filter_result_by_pvalue(kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]], threshold = 0.05)
  if (nrow(make_result_df(kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]])) > 0) {
    kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]] <- tryCatch(setReadable(kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]], OrgDb = annotation_orgdb, keyType = "ENTREZID"), error = function(e) kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]])
  } else {
    cat("[Step5] KEGG ORA", one_direction, "无可用结果，继续后续分析。\n")
  }

  reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]] <- run_clusterprofiler_with_retry(
    label = paste("Reactome ORA", one_direction),
    fn = function() ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = one_ids, universe = enrichment_universe_entrez, organism = reactome_organism, pvalueCutoff = 1, qvalueCutoff = 1, readable = TRUE),
    attempts = 3,
    sleep_seconds = 5,
    must_succeed = FALSE,
    timeout_seconds = 600
  )
  reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]] <- filter_result_by_pvalue(reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]], threshold = 0.05)
  if (nrow(make_result_df(reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]])) == 0) {
    cat("[Step5] Reactome ORA", one_direction, "无可用结果，继续后续分析。\n")
  }
  cat("[Step5] 完成", one_direction, "方向 GO/KEGG/Reactome ORA\n")
}

go_bp <- go_ora_sets$all$BP
go_mf <- go_ora_sets$all$MF
go_cc <- go_ora_sets$all$CC
go_all <- go_ora_sets$all$ALL
kegg_ora <- kegg_ora_sets$all
reactome_ora <- reactome_ora_sets$all

go_directional_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c("BP", "MF", "CC", "ALL"), function(one_ont) {
    bind_rows(lapply(names(go_ora_sets), function(one_direction) {
      extract_enrich_df(go_ora_sets[[one_direction]][[one_ont]], direction_label = one_direction, source_label = one_ont)
    }))
  })
)
kegg_directional_df <- combine_directional_enrichments(kegg_ora_sets, source_label = "KEGG")
reactome_directional_df <- combine_directional_enrichments(reactome_ora_sets, source_label = "Reactome")

geneList_gsea <- numeric(0)
if (nrow(rank_tbl) > 0) {
  geneList_gsea <- rank_tbl$rank_score
  names(geneList_gsea) <- rank_tbl$ENTREZID
  geneList_gsea <- sort(geneList_gsea, decreasing = TRUE)
}

geneList_symbol_gsea <- numeric(0)
if (nrow(de_result) > 0) {
  gene_rank_symbol_tbl <- de_result %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_label), gene_label != "", is.finite(rank_score)) %>%
    group_by(gene_label) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(rank_score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(desc(rank_score))
  geneList_symbol_gsea <- gene_rank_symbol_tbl$rank_score
  names(geneList_symbol_gsea) <- gene_rank_symbol_tbl$gene_label
  geneList_symbol_gsea <- sort(geneList_symbol_gsea, decreasing = TRUE)
}

if (length(geneList_gsea) >= 100) {
  cat("[Step7] 开始原生小鼠 GO GSEA，rank_n=", length(geneList_gsea), "\n")
  gsea_go_parts <- setNames(vector("list", 3), c("BP", "MF", "CC"))
  for (one_ont in names(gsea_go_parts)) {
    cat("[Step7] GO GSEA:", one_ont, "\n")
    set.seed(rnaseq_random_seed)
    gsea_go_parts[[one_ont]] <- run_clusterprofiler_with_retry(
      label = paste0("GO GSEA ", one_ont),
      fn = function() gseGO(
        geneList = geneList_gsea,
        OrgDb = annotation_orgdb,
        keyType = "ENTREZID",
        ont = one_ont,
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        seed = TRUE,
        verbose = FALSE
      ),
      attempts = 2,
      sleep_seconds = 2,
      must_succeed = FALSE
    )
    gsea_go_parts[[one_ont]] <- filter_result_by_pvalue(gsea_go_parts[[one_ont]], threshold = 0.05)
  }
  gsea_go_df <- combine_gsea_go_results(gsea_go_parts)
  gsea_go <- choose_primary_gsea_obj(gsea_go_parts)
  cat("[Step7] 完成原生小鼠 GO GSEA\n")
}

if (length(geneList_symbol_gsea) >= 100) {
  cat("[Step7] 原生小鼠 MH/M2/M5 GSEA，rank_n=", length(geneList_symbol_gsea), "\n")
  hallmark_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, mouse_bundle$libraries$Mouse_MH)
  mouse_m2_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, mouse_bundle$libraries$Mouse_M2)
  mouse_m5_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, mouse_bundle$libraries$Mouse_M5)
  mouse_kegg_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, mouse_bundle$libraries$Mouse_KEGG)
  mouse_reactome_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, mouse_bundle$libraries$Mouse_Reactome)
  gsea_hallmark_df <- if (is.null(hallmark_res)) data.frame() else hallmark_res$result
  gsea_mouse_m2_df <- mouse_m2_res$result
  gsea_mouse_m5_df <- mouse_m5_res$result
  gsea_kegg <- mouse_kegg_res$result
  gsea_reactome <- mouse_reactome_res$result
  gsea_reactome_df <- mouse_reactome_res$result

  human_hallmark_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, human_bundle$libraries$Human_Hallmark)
  human_c2_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, human_bundle$libraries$Human_C2)
  human_c5_res <- run_fgsea_symbol_sets(geneList_symbol_gsea, human_bundle$libraries$Human_C5)
  gsea_human_hallmark_df <- human_hallmark_res$result
  gsea_human_c2_df <- human_c2_res$result
  gsea_human_c5_df <- human_c5_res$result

  filter_gsea_display <- function(x) {
    if (!nrow(x)) return(x)
    x %>% filter(is.finite(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05) %>% arrange(pvalue, desc(abs(NES)))
  }
  gsea_hallmark_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_hallmark_df)
  gsea_mouse_m2_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_mouse_m2_df)
  gsea_mouse_m5_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_mouse_m5_df)
  gsea_kegg <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_kegg)
  gsea_reactome <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_reactome)
  gsea_reactome_df <- gsea_reactome
  gsea_human_hallmark_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_human_hallmark_df)
  gsea_human_c2_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_human_c2_df)
  gsea_human_c5_df <- filter_gsea_display(gsea_human_c5_df)
  cat("[Step7] 完成原生小鼠与人源同源补充 GSEA\n")
}

leading_edge_go <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_go_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_kegg <- extract_leading_edge_table(make_result_df(gsea_kegg), id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_hallmark <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_hallmark_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_reactome <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_reactome_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_mouse_m2 <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_mouse_m2_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_mouse_m5 <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_mouse_m5_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_human_hallmark <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_human_hallmark_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_human_c2 <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_human_c2_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)
leading_edge_human_c5 <- extract_leading_edge_table(gsea_human_c5_df, id_col = "ID", gene_col = "core_enrichment", top_n = 20)

enrichment_results <- bind_rows(
  standardize_enrichment_table(go_directional_df, "ORA", "GO", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(kegg_directional_df, "ORA", "KEGG", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(reactome_directional_df, "ORA", "Reactome", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_go_df, "GSEA", "GO", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(make_result_df(gsea_kegg), "GSEA", "KEGG", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_hallmark_df, "GSEA", "Mouse_MH", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_reactome_df, "GSEA", "Reactome", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_mouse_m2_df, "GSEA", "Mouse_M2", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_mouse_m5_df, "GSEA", "Mouse_M5", "06_enrichment")
) %>% mutate(origin = "mouse_native", db_species = "MM", analysis_species = "Mus musculus")
write_csv_safe(enrichment_results, file.path(step5_table_dir("all"), "enrichment_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

human_enrichment_results <- bind_rows(
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_human_hallmark_df, "GSEA", "Human_Hallmark", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_human_c2_df, "GSEA", "Human_C2", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_enrichment_table(gsea_human_c5_df, "GSEA", "Human_C5", "06_enrichment")
) %>% mutate(origin = "human_ortholog", db_species = "HS", analysis_species = "Mus musculus")
write_csv_safe(human_enrichment_results, file.path(human_table_dir, "enrichment_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

gsea_leading_edge <- bind_rows(
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_go, "GO", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_kegg, "KEGG", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_hallmark, "Mouse_MH", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_reactome, "Reactome", "06_enrichment"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_mouse_m2, "Mouse_M2", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_mouse_m5, "Mouse_M5", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway")
) %>% mutate(origin = "mouse_native")
write_csv_safe(gsea_leading_edge, file.path(step5_table_dir("all"), "gsea_leading_edge.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

human_gsea_leading_edge <- bind_rows(
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_human_hallmark, "Human_Hallmark", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_human_c2, "Human_C2", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway"),
  standardize_leading_edge_table(leading_edge_human_c5, "Human_C5", "06_enrichment", pathway_col = "pathway")
) %>% mutate(origin = "human_ortholog")
write_csv_safe(human_gsea_leading_edge, file.path(human_table_dir, "gsea_leading_edge.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (one_direction in names(kegg_ora_sets)) {
  one_table_dir <- step5_table_dir(one_direction)


}







write_csv_safe(gsea_human_hallmark_df, file.path(human_table_dir, "6_1_Human_Hallmark_GSEA_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_csv_safe(gsea_human_c2_df, file.path(human_table_dir, "6_2_Human_C2_GSEA_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_csv_safe(gsea_human_c5_df, file.path(human_table_dir, "6_3_Human_C5_GSEA_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

write_csv_safe(leading_edge_human_c5, file.path(human_table_dir, "6_3_Human_C5_leading_edge.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  Mouse_MH = length(hallmark_res$pathways),

)
```

## 6.2 KEGG / Reactome 图表

```{r}
if (nrow(kegg_directional_df) > 0) {
  save_directional_ora_plot(
    kegg_directional_df,
    file.path(step5_plot_dir("all"), "6_0_KEGG_directional_dotplot.pdf"),
    "Mouse native KEGG mmu ORA by direction"
  )
}
if (nrow(reactome_directional_df) > 0) {
  save_directional_ora_plot(
    reactome_directional_df,
    file.path(step5_plot_dir("all"), "6_0_Reactome_directional_dotplot.pdf"),
    "Mouse native Reactome ORA by direction"
  )
}

for (one_direction in names(kegg_ora_sets)) {
  one_plot_dir <- step5_plot_dir(one_direction)
  one_label <- direction_label(one_direction)
  if (nrow(make_result_df(kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]])) > 0) {
    save_kegg_family(
      kegg_ora_sets[[one_direction]],
      out_dir = one_plot_dir,
      prefix = "6_1_KEGG_ORA",
      title_prefix = paste("Mouse native KEGG mmu ORA", one_label)
    )
  }
  if (nrow(make_result_df(reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]])) > 0) {
    save_pathway_ora_family(
      reactome_ora_sets[[one_direction]],
      out_dir = one_plot_dir,
      prefix = "6_2_Reactome_ORA",
      title_prefix = paste("Mouse native Reactome", one_label)
    )
  }
}

if (nrow(gsea_mouse_m2_df) > 0) {
  save_gsea_df_dotplot(
    gsea_mouse_m2_df,
    file.path(step5_plot_dir("all"), "6_3_Mouse_M2_GSEA_dotplot.pdf"),
    title_prefix = "Mouse native MSigDB M2 GSEA",
    top_n = 20
  )
}
if (nrow(gsea_mouse_m5_df) > 0) {
  save_gsea_df_dotplot(
    gsea_mouse_m5_df,
    file.path(step5_plot_dir("all"), "6_4_Mouse_M5_GSEA_dotplot.pdf"),
    title_prefix = "Mouse native MSigDB M5 GSEA",
    top_n = 20
  )
}

for (human_plot_spec in list(
  list(data = gsea_human_hallmark_df, stem = "6_1_Human_Hallmark_GSEA_dotplot.pdf", title = "Human MSigDB Hallmark HS->Mus musculus ortholog GSEA"),
  list(data = gsea_human_c2_df, stem = "6_2_Human_C2_GSEA_dotplot.pdf", title = "Human MSigDB C2 HS->Mus musculus ortholog GSEA"),
  list(data = gsea_human_c5_df, stem = "6_3_Human_C5_GSEA_dotplot.pdf", title = "Human MSigDB C5 HS->Mus musculus ortholog GSEA")
)) {
  if (nrow(human_plot_spec$data) > 0) {
    save_gsea_df_dotplot(
      human_plot_spec$data,
      file.path(human_plot_dir, human_plot_spec$stem),
      title_prefix = human_plot_spec$title,
      top_n = 20
    )
  }
}
```
